text:
Ara Chen: FYI restoring tenant t-9483 snapshot to prod failed with KMS:DecryptionError during volume attach. Rolling back but wanted to flag here.
Mike Alvarez: Oof, when did the snapshot get taken?
Ara Chen: snapshot id s-2024-10-22-03, created Sat 03:12 UTC. We rotated CMK on Sat 02:00 per rotation job.
Sanjay Patel: suspected: rotation removed temporary grants? Any errors in restore logs?
Ara Chen: paste snippet:
```
error: Failed to decrypt data key: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123:assumed-role/backup-service is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/abcd
``` 
Mike Alvarez: that looks like grant missing. Did the rotation replace key ARN or change key policy?
Eva Thompson: Quick check: IAM changes were applied Sat 02:05 via infra PR #6123 (RBAC: restrict backup-service). Could be that.
Sanjay Patel: Can someone pull CloudTrail for KMS:Decrypt events around 03:12? Need to see if grant was issued and then revoked.
Ara Chen: @ops-bot pulling logs now... ops-bot: fetching CloudTrail events for kms:Decrypt between 2024-10-22T02:50 and 2024-10-22T03:30
ops-bot: found 4 events. 2 x kms:CreateGrant by key-owner, 2 x kms:RevokeGrant at 02:58 from role 'infra-automation'.
Mike Alvarez: RevokeGrant at 02:58 -> that's before snapshot. That explains missing grant.
Eva Thompson: Who approved the infra-automation revoke? Link?
Sanjay Patel: PR #6123 shows reviewers Ara, Mike, approved by Lisa M. It tightened role on backup-service. That might have caused infra-automation to drop ability to manage grants.
Ara Chen: Incident impact: 1 customer restore failed (t-9483). No data loss yet. We rolled back the restore attempt and flagged SEs.
Mike Alvarez: Short term remediation: re-create grant to allow backup-service to Decrypt and re-run restore. Suggested command:
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/ci-backups --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123:role/backup-service --operations Decrypt --name "restore-grant-<ts>"
```
Sanjay Patel: Also add a conditional key policy change to prevent infra-automation from accidentally revoking grants during rotation. Need RBAC exception for backup-service.
Eva Thompson: Sounds right. Also add audit alert: if kms:RevokeGrant happens within 1h of CreateGrant for same key, page oncall.
Ara Chen: Agreed. I'll open a change request for policy exception + alerting. Also we should surface this in the restore runbook.
Mike Alvarez: Forensics: save CloudTrail events + backup-service role trust policy. I'll stash artifacts in /mnt/incidents/t-9483.
Sanjay Patel: Ops decision: perform grant recreate now to complete customer restore? Anyone object?
Eva Thompson: Do it. @Ara can you coordinate with customer-facing team for ETA?
Ara Chen: Starting grant recreate now, will call the restore once verified. ETA 15m. I'll update thread.
deploy-bot: grant created: id g-07f8c9, created by Mike Alvarez at 2140509900
Ara Chen: restore re-run started. If successful we'll close and follow up with post-incident RFC for RBAC+KMS rotation.
Mike Alvarez: Postmortem items: 1) RBAC change review checklist 2) Grant-preservation test during key rotation 3) Alerting for revoke anomalies
Eva Thompson: Also add automated nightly test: rotate dev CMK and verify existing restore flow still works.
Ara Chen: Thanks all — will file the RFC and assign owners. Closing here after restore completes :thumbsup:
